headline_item.title_zh: 加拿大10月零售额预计下滑1.5%
headline_item.title_en: Canada Retail Sales Tracking Largest Decline Since Feb. 2025
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 受宏观经济疲软及劳动力市场停滞影响，加拿大10月零售销售额初步估计下降1.5%，创下2025年2月以来的最大跌幅
headline_item.event_summary_en: Statistics Canada reports an estimated 1.5% decline in retail sales for October, marking the sharpest drop since February 2025. CIBC senior economist Andrew Grantham noted that the decline reflects broader volume contraction and stagnant labor market growth, signaling weakening economic momentum heading into the final quarter of 2026.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】加拿大统计局、CIBC高级经济学家安德鲁·格兰瑟姆在加拿大宏观经济与零售市场：10月零售销售额预计下滑1.5%，为2025年2月以来最大单月跌幅
【起因与机理】消费需求减弱、汽油价格波动及劳动力市场长期缺乏增长动能
【关键数据与实测】10月零售额预计环比下滑1.5%，远逊于预期。
【各方立场与态度】分析人士建议加拿大央行暂缓紧缩政策以观察经济韧性。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Statistics Canada, CIBC Senior Economist Andrew Grantham: Retail sales estimated to decline by 1.5%, the largest drop since Feb 2025
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Weakening consumer demand, fuel price volatility, and stagnant labor market
[Key Metrics] 10% retail sales expected to fall 1.5%, significantly below forecasts.
[Key Position & Outlook] Analysts suggest the Bank of Canada pause tightening to monitor economic resilience.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 劳动力市场的结构性停滞已演变为消费下行的核心驱动力，这意味着加拿大央行在货币政策上将面临更强的暂停加息或转向宽松的压力。在外部贸易保护主义干扰下，内部需求疲软可能导致该国经济进入长期的低速增长通道。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The structural stagnation of the labor market has become the primary driver of consumption decline, forcing the Bank of Canada to reconsider its rate trajectory toward potential easing. Internal demand weakness, exacerbated by external trade frictions, suggests a shift toward a prolonged period of low-growth economic cycles.

headlines.title_zh: 谷歌Gemini推出Mac后台计算机操控功能
headlines.title_en: Google's Gemini can now run Mac apps and finish desktop chores in the background while you keep working
headlines.event_summary_zh: 谷歌在Mac版Gemini中引入“计算机使用”功能，允许AI在后台自动执行跨应用的复杂多步骤任务
headlines.event_summary_en: Google has integrated the 'Computer Use' feature into its Gemini Mac app, allowing the AI to simulate mouse clicks, keyboard inputs, and menu navigation within isolated background windows. This enables the autonomous execution of multi-step tasks across local files and web applications while allowing users to maintain foreground workflow continuity.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】谷歌（Alphabet 公司）在macOS桌面端生态：推出“计算机使用”功能，实现AI代理对本地应用与网页的跨平台自动化操作
【起因与机理】旨在通过自动化工作流闭环，解决AI辅助办公从对话交互向任务执行的跨越
【调查与监管诉求】核心功能：支持Gemini自主跨应用操作本地文件与浏览器界面。
【行业影响与走向】行业竞争：该技术直接对标OpenAI的Astra模型，加速AI代理落地桌面办公场景。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Google (Alphabet Inc.) (macOS Desktop Ecosystem): Introduced 'Computer Use' feature for cross-application autonomous task completion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To bridge the gap between conversational AI and functional task-oriented agentic workflows
[Key Fact Detail] Feature: Gemini autonomously operates local apps and browser interfaces.
[Key Position & Outlook] Competitive Landscape: Directly challenges OpenAI's Astra, accelerating AI agent adoption in desktop workflows.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次更新标志着大模型从意图理解范式向基于GUI驱动的Agent范式转型，通过将执行层剥离至受控后台，规避了AI实时交互与用户生产力冲突的痛点。该技术栈的成熟将迫使操作系统厂商重新定义系统级权限框架，以应对AI应用在复杂应用链条中对本地数据的自主获取与操作需求。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This update signals a shift from pure intent-understanding to GUI-driven agentic workflows, decoupling the execution layer to preserve user productivity. The maturation of such technology necessitates a fundamental redesign of OS-level permission frameworks to manage AI-driven autonomous access to heterogeneous local application data.

headlines.title_zh: 特朗普拟对海外建设数据中心课重税
headlines.title_en: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国总统特朗普提议对在海外建设AI数据中心的企业征收“巨额税款”，以防止算力基础设施外流
headlines.event_summary_en: U.S. President Donald Trump has proposed a 'tremendous tax' on American companies that construct AI data centers outside the country. This policy initiative is framed as a matter of national security, aiming to prevent the offshore migration of critical computing infrastructure and ensure the sovereignty of the domestic AI supply chain.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在美国政经决策会议场合：威胁对海外数据中心建设施加重税，强制算力资产回流美国
【起因与机理】防范地缘竞争对手获取算力资源及防止美国在AI基础设施领域被边缘化
【关键技术规格】核心诉求：防止算力基础设施外流，通过关税手段强制企业本土化建设。
【行业影响与走向】后续影响：面临国会两党法律博弈，或将重塑科技巨头全球基础设施布局策略。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] U.S. President Donald Trump: Threatened a 'tremendous tax' on offshore data centers to force domestic infrastructure investment
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To prevent geopolitical rivals from gaining computing power and to secure American AI infrastructure dominance
[Key Fact Detail] Core Demand: Preventing computing infrastructure flight via punitive tax measures.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Outlook: Subject to legislative hurdles in Congress; likely to reshape global infrastructure strategy for tech giants.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此举本质上是将算力基础设施提升至战略资源高度的强制性产业回流手段，可能大幅抬升跨国科技企业的资本支出成本。在该政策背景下，超大规模算力集群的规划将不再仅遵循电力与低成本土地的经济逻辑，而是必须接受国家地缘政治安全框架的严格规制，加剧全球算力供应链的碎片化进程。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This move elevates computing infrastructure to a strategic resource, enforcing industrial reshoring at the cost of significantly higher CAPEX for multinational tech firms. Future hyper-scale cluster planning must now balance traditional economic factors like power availability with restrictive geopolitical mandates, accelerating the fragmentation of the global AI supply chain.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
celebrity.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
